text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City, today's the recording for that cooking show, right!
Are you fully prepared?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I've come this far, so I just gotta do it,
I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever managed to make charred omelets, but
maybe a miracle will happen once it's the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Got it, this is my cue to step up!
I'll go get ready!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, ready?
............Why are you getting ready, Bamboo-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, as I was walking through the central plaza,
Bamboo Memory suddenly called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're the Trainer who helped out with
City's special cooking training back then!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Could you lend me a hand?
I'm rounding up people right now!
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but what are the extra hands for?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
An instant "OK"—that's so hot!! Much obliged!
Actually, there's something I need us to do together!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head to the studio.
Looks like fans are already gathering at the venue!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...My legs feel so heavy... Even though I said all that.
I have to brace myself, but...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Bamboo-senpai helped me out that much, too...
I can't go getting cold feet now—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
CITTTYYYYYYY!
Hold on a secooond~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, shout from the bottom of
your lungs for City's sake!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just like we practiced! We'll give it our all!
Osu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooooone, twooooo, THREE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Hooray!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fluffy! Melt-in-your-mouth!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YOOOO-HEAVE-HOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait... is this what you meant by "getting ready"?!
I mean, all the pedestrians are staring right at us...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to cheer you on, City—
I just expressed the origins of how I feel!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: City, you gotta return to your origins too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Why are you appearing on that cooking show?
What feelings do you want to convey?
What is it you want to show them?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Take another good, hard think about that!

text_block_list.name: TV Show AD
text_block_list.text:
Alright, starting recording now!
5 seconds, 4, 3—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(My origins... The reason I decided to
go on this cooking show in the first place was...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Right, yeah, that was it.
I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was finally the broadcast day for the cooking show
featuring Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Cooking Show MC
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, Gold City-san,
looking back on your dish today, how do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The burnt omelet had a pretty wild taste, even to me!
But... I gave it everything I had in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No eggshells got in either.
...If you challenge yourself without giving up, you get results.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think cooking is just like racing.
If I was able to show that to all the fans
who support me, I'd be really glad.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Also—there's a senpai who cheered me on
this whole time to an almost suffocating degree—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's my roommate too.
I really want to say thank you to that senpai, as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a great program where Gold City's hard work really shone through...!
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: UOOOOOHHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That was the abso-freaking-lute BEST show everrr!!!
Your feelings definitely reached your fans,
no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Cheering in front of the school gate...
was seriously, legit embarrassing, though!
Still, it made me realize what's truly important.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Bamboo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhh! City's fiery passion is striking
right through my heart!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I gotta throw all these surging emotions into something!!
I wanna burn, I wanna blaze up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm dashing towards the setting sun!!
Heading out right awayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Here she goes again...
I mean, it's still broad daylight...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess I can do the whole "youthful sprint" thing for today.
Senpai, wait up, I'm dashing toooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, settled! Starting now, 100 laps
around the training course—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chime~♪)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Bamboo Memory, report to the student council room immediately.
We have questions regarding the cheering disturbance
at the school gate the other day."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah!
Did I cheer a bit too passionately...?!
